thread:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — ACME reported a regression after yesterday's rollout. Their prompt that used to return a JSON invoice now returns a plain text summary. They say internal tests still pass. request_id=rcp_0a1b2c3d

sam_sre: Can you paste the exact prompt and the returned output? Also which model + variant were they hitting?

elaine_cs: prompt pasted below (from the customer):
```
System: You are an invoice extraction assistant. Output strictly JSON with fields: vendor, date, total, line_items.
User: Extract invoice from text: 
"""Invoice from WidgetsCo
Date: 2026-02-11
Total: $4,320.00
Items:
 - Widget A x2 $1,200.00
 - Setup fee $1,920.00
"""
```
Their request hit model: redwood-open-3b:v2 (hosted), route=prod/default. Response they got: 
```
Vendor: WidgetsCo
Date: Feb 11, 2026
Total: $4,320
Items: Widget A, Setup fee

Note: amounts are approximate.
```
This used to be structured JSON.

jules_evals: Internal evals (invoice-suite) ran against redwood-open-3b:v2 on our harness last night and passed all JSON-structure checks. No regressions flagged.

morgan_ml: Two quick hypotheses: 1) system prompt binding is being stripped / modified in the hosted route for some requests (so assistant loses strict JSON instruction), 2) tokenizer/normalization differences between our eval harness and customer's SDK leading to a different effective prompt (e.g., nonbreaking spaces, extra \r chars).

sam_sre: Also check whether the request hit a fallback variant (quantized or memory-optimized) during the rollout. deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed at 2026-03-11T21:05Z to 25% hosts; full rollout at 2026-03-12T03:14Z.

devon_prod: I pulled logs for request_id=rcp_0a1b2c3d — it landed on host host-32, scored as model variant "redwood-open-3b:v2-qp" which is the quantized performance variant. Latency 198ms. No obvious errors. Headers show Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 and X-User-Agent: ACME-invoice-client/1.2.

jules_evals: Our harness uses the canonical tokenizer library (tokenizer v1.8) and constructs prompts as raw strings (no normalization). Do we know if ACME's client library normalizes whitespace or adds special quoting?

elaine_cs: ACME support sent their request payload — they were using a wrapper that URL-encoded the prompt and then our gateway decoded it. I see a \u00A0 (NBSP) in the system line after decode.

morgan_ml: NBSP could break the exact match of the system instruction token sequence, causing model to lower-priority the JSON constraint. Worth reproducing by inserting NBSPs in the harness.

sam_sre: Action items: 1) Jules, run the invoice-suite with variations: NBSP in system prompt, extra \r, and using the quantized variant redwood-open-3b:v2-qp. 2) Devon, check routing logs for other similar requests from ACME around the same time — any other requests that hit the non-qp variant? 3) Elaine, ask ACME for full raw request headers + the exact SDK version.

jules_evals: Starting test run now. Will report pass/fail with diffs.

(devon_prod uploads logs)

devon_prod: I found three other ACME requests in the same minute. Two hit v2 (standard), one hit v2-qp. The non-JSON responses correlate with v2-qp only so far.

morgan_ml: That points at behavior divergence between v2 and v2-qp. Could be quantization-induced calibration shift causing softer adherence to system instructions. Also NBSP may amplify the change.

jules_evals: Test matrix results: canonical -> PASS. Insert NBSP in system line -> FAIL (model returns plain text). Canonical on v2-qp -> PASS but with lower confidence scores on instruction tokens. NBSP on v2-qp -> FAIL consistently.

elaine_cs: Sharing results with ACME, proposing immediate mitigation: 1) ask them to strip NBSPs client-side, 2) route ACME to non-qp variant for now until we roll a patch.

sam_sre: For short-term rollback we can add a routing rule: requests from ACME org id -> prefer redwood-open-3b:v2 (non-qp) for 24h. I'll prepare a canary rollback.

morgan_ml: Longer-term: we should add normalization step in gateway to collapse NBSP -> space before passing to model, and add token-level calibration tests for quantized variants in eval-suite. Also add a regression test: insert NBSP in system prompt for any strict-output evals.

jules_evals: Filed eval ticket EVAL-7213 for NBSP+quantized regression and added test to nightly.

elaine_cs: ACME accepted the temporary routing and confirmed that forcing non-qp variant restored JSON output in their repro. They're happy for now but want a postmortem and fix schedule.
